exposure: induction of labor by extra-amniotic balloon (EAB)
cohort: 266 women with singleton pregnancies and fetal growth restriction, undergoing induction of labor at term at a single medical center (2014-2017).
finding: After adjusting for confounding factors, extra-amniotic balloon and prostaglandin E2 had comparable maternal and neonatal outcomes when used for induction of labor due to fetal growth restriction.
mod_finding: The study compared extra-amniotic balloon (EAB) and prostaglandin E(2) (PGE(2)) for induction of labor due to fetal growth restriction (FGR) and found no significant differences in maternal or neonatal outcomes between the two methods.
